title: Hermes cron jobs
description: Recent run outcomes, success rate, and jobs that failed without a recent success.

panels.title: Jobs with a successful run in the last hour
panels.description: Count of agent and job pairs with a delivered or silent run in the last hour.

panels.title: 24h success rate by agent
panels.description: Delivered and silent runs divided by all outcomes. When job profile data is present, runs are attributed through the job ID; otherwise the runs_total agent label is used.

targets.expr:
(
  sum by (agent) (
    sum by (job_id) (label_replace(increase(hermes_cron_runs_total{outcome=~"delivered|silent"}[24h]), "job_id", "$1", "job", "(.+)"))
    * on (job_id) group_left (agent) max by (job_id, agent) (max_over_time(hermes_cron_job_profile[30d]))
  )
  /
  sum by (agent) (
    (
      (
        sum by (job_id) (label_replace(increase(hermes_cron_runs_total{outcome!="failed"}[24h]), "job_id", "$1", "job", "(.+)"))
        + on (job_id)
        sum by (job_id) (
          label_replace(sum by (agent, job) (increase(hermes_cron_runs_total{outcome="failed"}[24h])), "host", "$1", "agent", "([^/]+)/.*")
          * on (host, job) group_left (job_id)
          max by (host, job, job_id) (
            label_replace(label_replace(max_over_time(hermes_cron_job_info[30d]), "host", "$1", "agent", "([^/]+)/.*"), "job", "$1", "job_name", "(.+)")
          )
        )
      )
      or sum by (job_id) (label_replace(increase(hermes_cron_runs_total{outcome!="failed"}[24h]), "job_id", "$1", "job", "(.+)"))
      or sum by (job_id) (
        label_replace(sum by (agent, job) (increase(hermes_cron_runs_total{outcome="failed"}[24h])), "host", "$1", "agent", "([^/]+)/.*")
        * on (host, job) group_left (job_id)
        max by (host, job, job_id) (
          label_replace(label_replace(max_over_time(hermes_cron_job_info[30d]), "host", "$1", "agent", "([^/]+)/.*"), "job", "$1", "job_name", "(.+)")
        )
      )
    )
    * on (job_id) group_left (agent) max by (job_id, agent) (max_over_time(hermes_cron_job_profile[30d]))
  )
)
or on ()
(
  sum by (agent) (increase(hermes_cron_runs_total{outcome=~"delivered|silent"}[24h]))
  /
  sum by (agent) (increase(hermes_cron_runs_total[24h]))
)

panels.title: Run outcomes over time
panels.description: Run rate by outcome across the dashboard time range.

panels.title: Failing jobs without success in 6h
panels.description: Jobs with at least one failed run and no delivered or silent run during the last 6 hours.

targets.expr:
label_replace(
  sum by (agent, job) (increase(hermes_cron_runs_total{outcome="failed"}[6h])) > 0,
  "host", "$1", "agent", "([^/]+)/.*"
)
unless on (host, job)
label_replace(
  sum by (agent, job) (
    label_replace(
      sum by (agent, job) (increase(hermes_cron_runs_total{outcome=~"delivered|silent"}[6h]))
      * on (job) group_left (job_name)
        label_replace(max by (job_id, job_name) (max_over_time(hermes_cron_job_info[30d])), "job", "$1", "job_id", "(.+)"),
      "job", "$1", "job_name", "(.+)"
    )
  ) > 0,
  "host", "$1", "agent", "([^/]+)/.*"
)
